speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम् ।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः ॥
iast:
yatanto yoginaścainaṃ paśyantyātmanyavasthitam |
yatanto'pyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ ||
english: Yogis who strive see it dwelling within themselves; but those who are not inwardly prepared, lacking understanding, do not see it, even though they strive.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम् ।
यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् ॥
iast:
yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam |
yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam ||
english: The radiance in the sun that lights the whole world, the radiance in the moon and in fire: know that radiance to be mine.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा ।
पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ॥
iast:
gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmyahamojasā |
puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ ||
english: Entering the earth, I sustain all beings with my strength; and becoming the moon, the essence of sap, I nourish all plants.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः ।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥
iast:
ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamāśritaḥ |
prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmyannaṃ caturvidham ||
english: Becoming the fire of digestion, I dwell in the bodies of living beings and, joined with the in-breath and out-breath, digest the four kinds of food.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि संनिविष्टो ।
मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च ।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो ।
वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम् ॥
iast:
sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi saṃniviṣṭo |
mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca |
vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo |
vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham ||
english: I dwell in the heart of all; from me come memory, knowledge and their loss. I alone am what all the Vedas teach; I am the author of Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च ।
क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते ॥
iast:
dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca |
kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate ||
english: There are two persons in this world, the perishable and the imperishable. The perishable is all beings; the unchanging is called the imperishable.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः ।
यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः ॥
iast:
uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ |
yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ ||
english: But the highest Person is another, called the Supreme Self, the imperishable Lord who enters the three worlds and sustains them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः ।
अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
iast:
yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ |
ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||
english: Because I am beyond the perishable and higher even than the imperishable, I am known in the world and in the Veda as the highest Person.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो मामेवमसंमूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत ॥
iast:
yo māmevamasaṃmūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam |
sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata ||
english: Whoever, free of delusion, knows me in this way as the highest Person knows everything, and worships me with their whole being, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ ।
एतद्‌बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत ॥
iast:
iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayānagha |
etadbuddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata ||
english: So I have taught you this most secret teaching, sinless one. Understanding it, a person becomes wise and has done all there is to do, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः ।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
iast:
abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhirjñānayogavyavasthitiḥ |
dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam ||
english: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in the yoga of knowledge, generosity, self-restraint, sacrifice, study of scripture, austerity, honesty,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् ।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ॥
iast:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunam |
dayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam ||
english: non-violence, truthfulness, freedom from anger, renunciation, calm, not slandering others, compassion for all beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty and steadiness,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति संपदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥
iast:
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucamadroho nātimānitā |
bhavanti saṃpadaṃ daivīmabhijātasya bhārata ||
english: vigour, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from malice and from excessive pride: these belong to one born to the divine nature, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च ।
अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ संपदमासुरीम् ॥
iast:
dambho darpo'bhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva ca |
ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha saṃpadamāsurīm ||
english: Hypocrisy, arrogance, conceit, anger, harshness and ignorance belong to one born to the demonic nature, son of Pritha.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दैवी संपद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता ।
मा शुचः संपदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव ॥
iast:
daivī saṃpadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā |
mā śucaḥ saṃpadaṃ daivīmabhijāto'si pāṇḍava ||
english: The divine nature is thought to lead to liberation, the demonic to bondage. Do not grieve, son of Pandu: you are born to the divine nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ॥
iast:
dvau bhūtasargau loke'smindaiva āsura eva ca |
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu ||
english: There are two kinds of beings created in this world, the divine and the demonic. The divine has been described in detail; now hear from me about the demonic, son of Pritha.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥
iast:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ |
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate ||
english: The demonic do not know what to take up and what to turn away from; there is no purity in them, no good conduct, and no truth.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् ।
अपरस्परसंभूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम् ॥
iast:
asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram |
aparasparasaṃbhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam ||
english: They say the world is without truth, without foundation, without a Lord, not brought about by any order: what else is it but driven by desire?

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः ।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ॥
iast:
etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno'lpabuddhayaḥ |
prabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato'hitāḥ ||
english: Holding this view, these lost souls of small understanding and cruel deeds rise up as enemies of the world, for its destruction.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः ।
मोहाद्‌गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः ॥
iast:
kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ |
mohādgṛhītvāsadgrāhānpravartante'śucivratāḥ ||
english: Clinging to insatiable desire, full of hypocrisy, pride and arrogance, holding wrong ideas out of delusion, they act with impure intentions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः ।
कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः ॥
iast:
cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥ |
kāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niścitāḥ ||
english: Given over to boundless anxieties that end only with death, taking the enjoyment of desires as the highest aim, convinced that this is all there is,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः ।
ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान् ॥
iast:
āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ |
īhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasañcayān ||
english: bound by hundreds of ropes of hope, given over to desire and anger, they strive to pile up wealth by unjust means to satisfy their desires.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम् ।
इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम् ॥
iast:
idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manoratham |
idamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam ||
english: "This I have gained today; this wish I will fulfil. This wealth is mine, and this too will be mine.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि ।
ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी ॥
iast:
asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapi |
īśvaro'hamahaṃ bhogī siddho'haṃ balavānsukhī ||
english: That enemy has been killed by me, and I will kill others too. I am the lord, I am the enjoyer; I am successful, powerful and happy.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया ।
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः ॥
iast:
āḍhyo'bhijanavānasmi ko'nyo'sti sadṛśo mayā |
yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ ||
english: I am rich and well-born; who else is like me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will rejoice." So they speak, deluded by ignorance.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः ।
प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ॥
iast:
anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ |
prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake'śucau ||
english: Bewildered by many thoughts, caught in the net of delusion, attached to the enjoyment of desires, they fall into a foul hell.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आत्मसंभाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः ।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
iast:
ātmasaṃbhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ |
yajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam ||
english: Self-important, stubborn, full of pride and the intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only, out of hypocrisy, not according to the rules.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः ।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः ॥
iast:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ |
māmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto'bhyasūyakāḥ ||
english: Given over to ego, force, arrogance, desire and anger, these resentful people hate me, who dwell in their own bodies and in those of others.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रुरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् ।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु ॥
iast:
tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krurānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān |
kṣipāmyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu ||
english: These hateful, cruel, vilest of people, I hurl again and again into the cycles of rebirth, into demonic wombs alone.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि ।
मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम् ॥
iast:
āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani |
māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim ||
english: Falling into demonic wombs, deluded birth after birth, never reaching me, son of Kunti, they sink to the lowest state.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः ।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥
iast:
trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ |
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet ||
english: Threefold is this gate of hell that destroys the self: desire, anger and greed. So one should give up these three.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः ।
आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
etairvimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvāraistribhirnaraḥ |
ācaratyātmanaḥ śreyastato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
english: Freed from these three gates to darkness, son of Kunti, a person does what is truly good for the self, and so reaches the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः ।
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ॥
iast:
yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ |
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim ||
english: One who sets aside the injunctions of scripture and acts on the impulse of desire attains neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ ।
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि ॥
iast:
tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau |
jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi ||
english: So let scripture be your authority in deciding what should and should not be done. Knowing what scripture prescribes, you should do your work here.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः ॥
iast:
ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ |
teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ ||
english: Krishna, what is the standing of those who set aside the rules of scripture but worship with faith: is it sattva, rajas or tamas?

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा ।
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु ॥
iast:
trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā |
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu ||
english: The faith of embodied beings is of three kinds, born of their own nature: sattvic, rajasic and tamasic. Hear about it.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत ।
श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ॥
iast:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata |
śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ||
english: Everyone's faith is in keeping with their inner nature, Arjuna. A person is made of their faith: whatever their faith is, that is what they are.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः ।
प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः ॥
iast:
yajante sāttvikā devānyakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ |
pretānbhūtagaṇāṃścānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ ||
english: Sattvic people worship the gods; rajasic people, yakshas and rakshasas; and others, tamasic people, worship ghosts and hosts of spirits.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः ।
दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः ॥
iast:
aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ |
dambhāhaṃkārasaṃyuktāḥ kāmarāgabalānvitāḥ ||
english: Those people who practise terrible austerities not prescribed by scripture, full of hypocrisy and ego, driven by the force of desire and passion,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः ।
मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान् ॥
iast:
karṣayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmamacetasaḥ |
māṃ caivāntaḥśarīrasthaṃ tānviddhyāsuraniścayān ||
english: senselessly tormenting the elements in the body, and me too, who dwell within the body: know them to be of demonic resolve.
